evidence.quote: ICTS Europe Systems, ICTS Europe’s technological arm, has introduced Eagle to Namibia Airports Company, a state-owned enterprise and owner of eight airports nationally.
It is commercially available at various European and South African airports and is regularly used by leading airlines and freight forwarders, among them Air France and DHL.
